name: Bloxtopia (\href{https://bloxtopia.gg}{bloxtopia.gg})
description: Built a rewards platform for Roblox players with Next.js and Nodemailer, enabling users to complete sponsored tasks and redeem earnings for Robux. Collaborated with teammates to resolve frontend–backend integration issues by introducing a gateway layer that centralized mock data for testing and routed production requests to backend services.

name: Nemotron (\href{https://github.com/DMax1314/Nemotron}{github.com/DMax1314/Nemotron})
description: Wrote fine-tuning scripts for a three-person team, coordinating execution on teammates’ H200 GPU resources to improve NVIDIA Nemotron’s reasoning accuracy from 30\% to 85\%.

name: Outpost (\href{https://app.jameschen.life/outpost/repo}{app.jameschen.life/outpost/repo})
description: Automated Minecraft server provisioning on DigitalOcean, uploading game files at startup and downloading them at shutdown.

name: Burrow (\href{https://github.com/TypingHare/burrow}{github.com/TypingHare/burrow})
description: Created an extensible CLI platform with startup times under 20 milliseconds and built-in modules for configuration, HTTP server startup, and self-updates.

name: BG Clock (\href{https://bgc.jameschen.life}{bgc.jameschen.life})
description: A responsive touchscreen clock application for board games like Go and Chess, built with \textbf{Vite}, \textbf{React}, and \textbf{Chakra UI}. It has an internal modular game core with a precise game loop for accurate timekeeping, and an extensible trigger system for flexible mode support. (Live Demo: \href{https://bgc.jameschen.life}{https://bgc.jameschen.life})
